note: King Solomon began construction on the first Holy Temple in Jerusalem (see 2 Chronicles 3:1). Messiah appeared to the disciples and they miraculously caught 153 fish (possible date, see John 21). *Dag Ba'Omer means “Fish in the Omer.” It is a fun play on the name Lag Ba’Omer (see Day 33 of the Omer). Some Messianic believers celebrate it by going to a lake, river, or sea in the morning. They pray, grill fish, and remember the story in John 21, when Yeshua met his disciples by the water and ate fish with them. Day 17 of the Omer
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
